args.title: Juniper Labware newsletter — Warehouse automation in 2026
args.body:
• Newsletter: Juniper Labware's latest weekly issue is "Warehouse automation in 2026"; it links to a blog article and offers matching case studies to readers on an active project.
• Article (blog.juniper.example/2026/warehouse): pick rates rose 18% with autonomous carts, but integration took twice as long as planned.
• Companion piece (insights.juniper.example/warehouse/companion): the biggest saving came from fewer mis-picks.
